again.description: Read a crawl, or send a search query, again although an earlier run did.

check.description: Check at most this many boards against their ATS: unchecked ones first (oldest found first), then any last checked over 7 days ago (or fetched by ingest), oldest first; default all, 0 checks none.

crawl.description: A Common Crawl crawl id such as `CC-MAIN-2026-43`; default the newest.

from.description: Where to look for company boards: `commoncrawl` (Common Crawl's URL index), `exa` or `parallel` (a web search API, keyed by `EXA_API_KEY` or `PARALLEL_API_KEY`), or a file of board URLs or ids (`ashby:<slug>`), one per line.

queries.description: For `exa` and `parallel`: what to search for; each query is one search per ATS (34 Ashby, 33 Greenhouse and 33 Lever results), kept to that ATS's board hosts; default a dozen roles and sectors.
